userStories.title: Fix URL normalization - preserve path case to fix broken redirect links
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fix a critical bug where normalizeUrl lowercases the entire URL including the path. Newsletter redirect links (e.g., https://links.tldrnewsletter.com/AbCdEf) are case-sensitive tokens that get corrupted when lowercased, causing 404s. Only the hostname should be lowercased.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/lib/utils/url.ts, change normalizeUrl to only lowercase the hostname, not the full URL
Path, query string, and fragment case must be preserved
normalizeUrl('https://LINKS.tldrnewsletter.com/AbCdEf?UTM_SOURCE=email') returns 'https://links.tldrnewsletter.com/AbCdEf' (hostname lowercased, path preserved, utm stripped)
Existing tracking param stripping and www removal still work
userStories.notes: P1 critical bug. Affects all newsletter redirect links. Fix: parse URL, lowercase only parsed.hostname, do not call url.toLowerCase() on the full URL string before parsing.

Change headline style textDecoration from 'none' to 'underline'
All article headlines in the digest email are visually distinguishable as links
Footer links (Manage preferences, Unsubscribe) retain their existing lavender styling
userStories.notes: P1 UX bug. Links exist in HTML but are invisible - same color as body text with no underline. Simple 2-line style change.

userStories.title: Fix TLDR truncation and cache takeaways per batch
userStories.description: As a subscriber, I want the Key Takeaways section to display complete, untruncated text. As a developer, I want TLDR to be generated once per digest run and reused for all users to reduce Claude API costs.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix truncation: in DigestEmail.tsx, replace nested <span> bullet with plain text bullet character directly in the string (e.g., `• ${takeaway}` as a single Text element with no nested span). Remove tldrBullet span style entirely.
Cache TLDR: add a digest_cache table via migration with columns: id (uuid PK), cache_key (text unique), takeaways (text array), created_at
In sendDigests.ts, generate TLDR once before the user loop using a cache_key of format `{date}-{frequency}` (e.g., '2026-04-01-daily')
Check digest_cache for existing entry before calling generateTLDR
Store result in digest_cache after generation
Pass same takeaways to all users in the batch
userStories.notes: P1. Two fixes in one: (1) truncation caused by span-in-Text rendering in email clients, (2) cost reduction by generating TLDR once per batch not per user.

userStories.title: Weekly digest: themes-only AI summary with no individual article links

In sendDigest.ts, detect if user frequency is 'weekly' and use WeeklyDigestEmail template instead of DigestEmail
Cache weekly summary in digest_cache table with cache_key format 'weekly-{YYYY-WW}'
Update FrequencySelector.tsx helper text for weekly option to: 'Every Monday — a curated AI summary of the week\'s key themes. No individual article links.'
Update verify-success page text to differentiate: daily users see 'Your first digest arrives tomorrow morning', weekly users see 'Your first weekly summary arrives next Monday'
userStories.notes: P1. Weekly = themes-only summary format. No article list, no backlinks. Cleaner for weekly cadence. AI disclaimer required. Separate email template from daily digest.

userStories.title: Fix Claude URL extraction — prefer redirect URLs over guessing original
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Claude article extraction prompt updated to explicitly prefer the newsletter redirect URL rather than trying to infer the original article URL. If multiple links exist for an item, prefer the most specific one.'

userStories.title: Fix email tag pills rendering in Outlook (React Email inline-block)
userStories.description: As a subscriber using Outlook, I want article tags to render correctly. Currently tags use display:inline-block inside a React Email <Text> component which Outlook does not support, causing tags to stack vertically or render broken.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/emails/DigestEmail.tsx, replace the tags <Text> + nested <span> approach with a React Email compatible layout
Use a <Row>/<Column> or plain comma-separated text fallback: render tags as plain text joined by ' · ' (e.g. 'LLMs · Agents · Research') inside a single <Text> element with no nested spans
Tag text should be muted (color: '#9B9B9B') and smaller (fontSize: '12px')
Remove the tag and tags style objects that use display: inline-block
userStories.notes: P2. React Email <Text> components do not reliably support display:inline-block children. Outlook in particular breaks. Plain text comma/dot separated tags are universally safe.

userStories.description: As the operator, I want a page at /admin/preview-digest that renders a live preview of what today's digest will look like for a given subscriber email, so I can QA the content and layout before the cron sends it.
acceptanceCriteria: Page has a form: email input + 'Preview' button
On submit, fetch unsent articles for that user (same logic as sendDigest), render DigestEmail or WeeklyDigestEmail component, and display it inline in an iframe or styled div
Shows message if user email not found or no articles to send
Add link to this page from the /admin dashboard
userStories.notes: P2. Currently no way to QA emails before they go out. Operator must wait for the cron to fire.

userStories.title: Add token usage logging for Claude API calls
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to log Claude API token usage (input tokens, output tokens, estimated cost) for each extraction and TLDR generation call so I can audit and optimize API costs.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/lib/ai/anthropic.ts, after each API call log: model name, input_tokens, output_tokens from response.usage to console
userStories.notes: P2. Simple console logging of usage stats. No DB storage needed — Vercel logs capture these. Helps identify expensive newsletters.

userStories.title: Add database archiving and pruning strategy for articles and ingestion logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a strategy to prevent unbounded growth of the articles and ingestion_log tables as the pipeline runs daily.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a SQL migration that adds a scheduled Supabase pg_cron job (or document a manual process) to: delete ingestion_log rows older than 90 days, delete articles rows older than 180 days where the article has been sent to all active subscribers (check user_article_log)
Alternatively, create a /api/admin/prune endpoint protected by ADMIN_SECRET that runs the cleanup queries on demand
Document the pruning strategy in a comment in the migration or endpoint
userStories.notes: P2. At current scale (10 newsletters/blogs × 10 articles/day = 100 articles/day = 36,500/year) the DB will grow significantly. ingestion_log grows even faster.
